name: Sam Moore
learned: Sam Moore is Jennifer Moore's father. A sound specialist who formed a Performance Team with Andrew Williams and David Evans and remains very close to them. He holds a moderate, steady conviction that climate change is real and increasingly consequential, but he tends to frame it as a serious public-health and risk-management challenge rather than an immediate existential emergency; he emphasizes practical, evidence-based steps and the avoidable harms of delay without using alarmist language. His trust in government is very low: he is skeptical about whether agencies and elected leaders will act transparently or consistently, and he expects political constraints and weak follow-through unless there is clear accountability. Even so, as an institutional optimist and policy ally in temperament, he prefers to engage formal processes—supporting well-designed regulation and public programs—while pushing hard for measurable targets, oversight, and faster implementation because he does not assume institutions will deliver on their own.
